# Website shows

`shows.json` lists the shows the website's app screens are rendered with:
title, native title, year, format, episodes, genres, score, studio, a short
description and the first episodes. `<id>-b.jpg` is the banner, `<id>-c.jpg`
the cover and `<id>-e<n>.jpg` the episode stills. `site_screens_test.dart`
reads them; nothing is downloaded when it runs.
